title: Seedance 2.5 one-take Draft to Final
draftFlagSource: Selecting model option Seedance 2.5 Draft sets draft true on the Partner task. There is no separate draft checkbox.
finalResolutionSource: ByteDance2DraftToFinalVideoNode submits resolution 1080p with model dreamina-seedance-2-5-260628.

seed.rule: Set control_after_generate to fixed before promote, and keep the integer that produced the approved draft. The node tooltip states results are non-deterministic regardless of seed; fixed stops Comfy from changing the seed and minting a new draft_task_id on the next Stage 1 queue.

generateAudio.rule: false when post owns audio. true only when the take itself must carry dialogue or sound effects. The final node inherits this setting.

i2vNote: Template api_seedance2_5_draft_i2v uses ByteDance2FirstLastFrameNode. Seedance 2.5 on that node has no ratio widget and submits ratio adaptive from the first frame. Supply a 16:9 plate. last_frame stays unconnected for a one-take from the start frame.
promptShape: 16:9, cinematic, single continuous take. Refs: @Image1 character, @Image2 location, @Clay Render 1 blocking. 0–10s: the character crosses into the location and lands the clay-blockout mark. 10–20s: one continuous move, camera stays with them, wardrobe unchanged. 20–30s: they settle on the end mark in the same light. No subtitles, No BGM. Keep identity/wardrobe locked.
